notes.chord_correction_majboor: Source document listed Am-F-C-G with Capo 2. Verified sources (Chordify, GuitarTwitt) confirm actual key is G with chords Em-Bm-C-D (no capo). Both representations are functionally equivalent – Capo 2 + Am shapes = same pitch as no-capo Em shapes. DB stores both.
notes.chord_correction_bairan: Source listed Em-C-G-D with Capo 1. Verified key is F major. Multiple sources confirm C-Am-F-G with Capo 5 as easiest playable shape, or F-Dm-Bb-C without capo. DB stores verified easy shape.
notes.gehra_hua_singers: Source listed only Arijit Singh. Verified: sung by Arijit Singh AND Armaan Khan. Composer: Shashwat Sachdev. Lyricist: Irshad Kamil.
notes.bairan_release: Released January 23, 2026 – Sony Music India / Brown Records.
notes.majboor_release: Released September 11, 2025 – Warner Music South Asia / B2 Labels.

schema_notes.how_to_add_songs: Increment ID (S026, S027...), fill all fields. Set verification_flag to PARTIAL until cross-checked against at least 2 independent sources (Shazam/Spotify for metadata, Chordify/UltimateGuitar/GuitarTwitt for chords). Update indexes[] accordingly.
schema_notes.chord_convention: chords_no_capo = absolute pitch chords. chords_with_capo_alt = playable open shapes with capo at capo_alt fret. easy_shape = recommended beginner shape string.
schema_notes.lyrics_policy: Lyrics stored as structural reference only (verse/chorus/bridge blocks with inline chord markers). Not full reproductions. For personal practice use only.

verification_levels.VERIFIED: Metadata and chords confirmed via 2+ independent online sources
verification_levels.PARTIAL: Artist/song confirmed; chord shape based on key analysis or single source; recommend independent spot-check before performance
